developers: @dakio/sdk is a free MIT-licensed package on npm. A developer builds their own React or Next.js storefront and Dakio runs the business behind it: catalog, server-priced quotes, cash-on-delivery checkout with fake-order protection and an SMS code step, couriers, stock, abandoned carts, the Meta Pixel, webhooks and Nova. No backend is needed. Client keys start with dk_pub and are browser-safe and domain-locked; secret keys start with dk_sec and stay on a server. Test keys are free and every plan includes API keys. The docs are at dakio.io/developers/docs, in English. Agencies can build client stores on it.
themes: There are eight complete storefront designs, one for each kind of shop Bangladeshi sellers usually start with: fashion, beauty, jewellery, furniture, grocery, baby, modest wear and books. Each becomes the shop's own website on its own domain, with Dakio's catalog, cash-on-delivery checkout with an SMS code, and couriers behind it. The showroom at dakio.io/themes has a page per theme.
switch: Moving over takes one weekend. Friday: the owner gives one CSV export and store access, and the team maps products, variants, customers and order history overnight. Saturday: everything is imported and the storefront is rebuilt in Store Studio with a theme the owner picks; the owner reviews and corrects. Sunday: the domain and redirects go live, old links keep working, and Nova starts its first night shift. Products, variants, customers, order history, reviews, images and the domain all move. Themes do not transfer between platforms; the owner rebuilds the look in Store Studio, usually in an afternoon. No contract, monthly billing, data exports to CSV anytime. A typical Shopify stack in Bangladesh (subscription in dollars, apps, payment workarounds, a designer) costs around 16,500 taka a month.
credits: A Nova credit is one finished piece of work, not a token or an API call: a customer reply, a listing written from a photo, an ad creative, a recovered cart, a drafted reorder. The Hours-Saved report shows every credit and what it was worth. When credits run out Nova switches to Draft mode: it keeps preparing replies and campaigns as drafts and executes nothing until the owner tops up, 250 taka for 250 credits, or the month resets. Prepared work runs the moment the owner tops up. There is no unlimited plan because Nova does real work on real compute; an honest meter is better than hidden throttling.
voice: Nova can phone the owner: the 6 AM morning brief as a call, and watchdog alerts when something goes wrong, for example an ad's spend spiking. It can also call customers to confirm cash-on-delivery orders before dispatch, in Bangla or English. Every call is recorded, transcribed and receipted. Voice minutes come with the Business plan.
data: The owner's data belongs to the owner: products, customers and orders export to CSV anytime, and there is no contract. Every Nova action writes a receipt in a ledger, and reversible actions can be undone. Nova acts only inside guardrails the owner sets; refunds, guardrails and contracts stay with the owner. Privacy policy, terms, refund policy and data deletion are on the website footer.
suppliers: Supplier Network lets a shop sell without holding stock. Verified suppliers hold the products; the shop lists them and sells; when an order comes in, Dakio packs and ships it from the supplier's stock and collects cash on delivery. Supplier margins are shown with the products. It is included on the Growth and Business plans.

ads: Ads Gallery: pick a product and one click fills an editable, on-brand ad in three sizes (square 1:1, 4:5 and 9:16 for stories and reels), static or motion. There are ten templates plus your own, a brand engine with eleven colour roles taken from the store's theme, five motion recipes, background removal, Bangla ad text, and real PNG export. The Creative Doctor checks each ad before it ships. A live demo is on dakio.io/ads.
studio: Store Studio is the storefront builder: a live canvas where you click a headline and type, a theme gallery, Bangla font packs, a dark storefront, 14 section types, mobile preview and control, inline editing, and undo with versions. One theme powers both the storefront and the ads. A live demo is on dakio.io/store-studio.
front_office: Front Office puts Messenger, Instagram, WhatsApp and email into one thread per customer. Nova answers in Bangla with human pacing, takes an order only after the customer says yes, confirms before dispatch with RTO Shield, and escalates to the owner with a context brief. The owner can take over any thread instantly. It starts in shadow mode and the owner promotes it step by step with an autonomy dial. Hard lines: no order without consent, refunds are owner-only, and if a customer asks 'bot naki?' Nova answers honestly. A live demo is on dakio.io/front-office.
grow: Grow Suite has six levers. Campaigns: the season planned ahead on a quarter calendar (Eid, Puja, 11.11). Content: a month of posts scheduled at the hours buyers scroll. Broadcast: targeted messages to lapsed buyers, with cool-off protection. Research: demand curves to spot the next winning product early, with supplier margins. Growth: opportunities with evidence, maths and risk, to apply or skip. Goals: pace, forecast and the lever that closes the gap. Nova pulls these levers overnight and leaves anything big for the owner's approval.
nova_levels: Nova's authority grows with trust. On day one it is an L3 Operator: it executes routine work inside guardrails and sends bigger moves to the owner as decision cards. After 50 clean approvals it can be promoted to L4 Acting CEO, and the owner confirms the promotion. Authority is per department, so marketing can be autonomous while finance still asks first. Refunds, guardrails and contract signing are owner-only forever.
couriers: Steadfast, Pathao and RedX are built in. Pickup is booked as soon as an order is confirmed, addresses are not copy-pasted, and cash-on-delivery collection is tracked to the taka and reconciled. Courier charges are billed per delivery at the courier's own rate, with no markup from Dakio.
payments: Checkout takes bKash, Nagad, cards and cash on delivery natively, with no plugins and no dollar fees. bKash payments reach the shop from its first order. An SMS code step at checkout and fake-order protection cut fake cash-on-delivery orders. Dakio's own subscription is paid through SSLCommerz in taka.
